title: The Shadow (master-spy theme)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: Dark, cool modern spy-thriller theme with a cold Russian colour. 100 BPM in a tight, sneaking half-time groove, D minor with chromatic half-step bends. Electronic sounds lead: a clean, gritty synth bass riff carries a 2-bar spy motif that repeats again and again, with a ticking clock-like pulse and tight processed drums. Colour: a tremolo balalaika and low pizzicato strings answering the motif, deep low brass swells, a cold icy piano note; a veena with a few slow bending notes as a ghostly third layer. Vocals: only a deep, low Russian-style male choir humming wordless notes underneath, no lyrics, no singer. 0-10 s: the hidden spy: the bass riff and ticking pulse alone, cold and tense. 10-12 s: one sharp hit and the full motif. 12-40 s: the groove locks in, balalaika, strings and brass answer the motif, layers keep adding, suspense growing. 40-52 s: the full chase, everything together, low choir rising. 52-60 s: the motif one last time and a cold, sharp ending hit. No silence or long pauses, no side-chain pumping, no EDM drops; clear, tonal, punchy, very loud cinematic mix; no white-noise sweeps, no harsh fuzz, no even sixteenth-note hi-hat rolls.

brief.notes: Flavour: riff-and-bass groove (R7). Electronic lead, Russian colour (balalaika, low male choir), veena as a ghostly third layer. No names in the prompt.

story: A cold, clever master spy: always three moves ahead, Russian winter, a long black coat, quiet danger.
